description: Select a live renderer surface by the opaque id returned by electron_surfaces_list. Following snapshot, find, renderer reads/eval, waits, expectations, and interactions target that surface; a ref from a different surface is rejected rather than reused. Returns: { ok, session_id, active, active_surface_id }. Errors: SURFACE_NOT_FOUND (the id was never observed in this session), SURFACE_CLOSED (it detached or closed), SURFACE_UNSUPPORTED (the live surface cannot be driven), TRANSPORT_UNSUPPORTED, NOT_RUNNING, BAD_ARGUMENT.

sessionId.description: Target session id. Omit when a single session is running.

name: electron_switch_surface
title: Switch active renderer surface
